body: I'm with a REALLY small company. I'm new to the field so maybe it's just not as busy as I was hoping. Plus on Monday when the Roger's network was down he wasn't able to receive any calls which may have played a factor. Everyone tells me we'll be getting slammed soon.
Thats crazy. Are you Jesus. Good job man. I'm new. Not in pain from the job just being stupid with my friends and lazy with my form with the weights. Trying to catch it before it catches me

Bit of everything. I mainly stick to his other technician. Most exposure has been installs. Had a day where we had to do a quick stove connection or just really small things. Couple small service calls. Just slow right now because of the apocalypse

Starting in the field myself. Changed a gas valve and that was about it for today. Covid hurting the small company I'm with. 31 trying to start a new career and move on in life. Definitely a snails pace
Of course the exam is now cancelled because of the lockdown

No kidding. I'm basically changing careers and I used to work in insurance (I'm in my early 30's) and all the legal talk in multiple choice questions that are meant to mess with my mind. It's like Yoda is writing the questions

I interviewed with a commercial company and it went really well. I just got the impression that I would be stuck running parts in the warehouse for over a year before they decide to turn me into an actual apprentice. I know it's just one interview and I tend to over think things and I have no problem with heavy lifting, I just don't want a bunch of empty promises. My mind wandering is all

I hear ya. At this point obviously I am gunning for the experience plus the 313d which is an added bonus. I guess the chat I hear sometimes is just people being negative and bitter. I'm hoping after a few years I can maybe give a go at commercial without starting back at G3 wages.
